truist-arena.chronic.1.text: Outside food is not allowed. Separately, the bag policy permits exceptions for medical bags after inspection. The bag exception does not establish permission to bring outside food.
quote: Patrons may not bring food into Truist Arena.
A Clear Bag Policy is in effect all shows/events.
Exceptions can be made for Medical bags/Diaper bags after a proper inspection.
truist-arena.chronic.1.reason: Distinguish the medical-bag exception from the separate outside-food prohibition; no food exception inferred.
